name: "Everything Spice" Baked Salmon Rice Bowl with Avocado & Tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 pints grape tomatoes
3 lemons
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, divide tomatoes between two baking sheet pans. Drizzle with oil and season with salt. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until tomatoes are just beginning to burst, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, place seeds and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine the "everything spice" mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp sesame seeds
1 tbsp poppy seeds
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the salmon dry with paper towels, season with salt, and place, skin-side down, on a plate. Spread the top-side with Dijon, then sprinkle evenly with the spice mixture, pressing gently to adhere. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb salmon fillet
¾ tsp salt
3 tbsp Dijon mustard

instructions.primary_message: When the tomatoes are starting to burst, remove from the oven. Add salmon to the baking sheets, nestling the fillets into the tomatoes.
Return baking sheets to the oven and continue to roast until the tomatoes are browned and salmon is cooked through, 8-10 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemons into the reserved bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocados. Halve lengthwise and slice thinly while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide rice between bowls. Top with salmon, roasted tomatoes, avocado, and capers, then drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
